description:
Use this when the user asks about open interest, put-call ratio or futures and options positioning for an Indian stock or an index such as NIFTY or BANKNIFTY.

Returns the latest trading day's totals across all contracts of one F&O underlying: futures open interest and its change, call and put open interest, the put-call ratio (put open interest divided by call open interest) volume, and whether it is in the ban list. `query` is a stock's NSE symbol, ISIN or BSE code, or an index name such as NIFTY or BANKNIFTY. Only stocks that trade in F&O have data. For positions by participant type across the market use get_fo_participant_activity.

query.description: A stock's NSE symbol, ISIN or BSE code, or an F&O index name such as NIFTY or BANKNIFTY.
